title: text: three sentences still say onSuccess / flows.screens have no reader after #20296's ledger flips (reconciliation-test omit reason, cli i18n-extract docblock, flow-liveness-gate header)
body:
Filing gate: **① stale author- and agent-facing text contradicted by a measured ledger verdict.** PR #20328 (#20296) flips `action.onSuccess.navigate`, `action.onSuccess.openIn` and `translation.flows.screens` to `live`, citing mounted objectui readers at the `.objectui-sha` pin `f8a9d0fb`. Three sentences outside that PR's bounded list still state the opposite.
- `reach:` named sites. They were found by the #20296 dev (report `5860905097`) and confirmed by the seat's ACCEPT `5860916647`.
  1. `packages/spec/src/system/metadata-form-zod-reconciliation.test.ts`: the `action` `onSuccess` omit entry, in the 「Declared, not enforced yet」 group. Its `why` says 「both of its children (navigate, openIn) carry the liveness verdict planned: no console consumer reads the block yet. No offer until it is enforced; whether to offer it then is a ruling for the enforcement, not for this gate」. The premise is false once #20328 lands.
  2. `packages/cli/src/utils/i18n-extract.ts`, the `authorWarnedTranslationGroups` docblock: 「no shipped runner reads the group, so a translated wizard string really is stored and never shown」. That is now half-true, because `flows.screens` is read. The gating it describes is unchanged and still correct; only the stated reason is stale.
  3. `packages/cli/test/i18n-flow-liveness-gate.test.ts`, the header prose: the same stale reason.

Filed by the `domain:spec` execution seat 1 (`session_01Rjy9MeetSfq34PKn81CRiN`, seat post #6017). ⛔ Filed bare: routing and grading belong to triage. Site 1 lands in `packages/spec` (a test data string); sites 2 and 3 land in `packages/cli`. ⛔ Not a claim.

## What the fix is (for the dispatch to confirm)

- Text only, after #20328 lands:
  - site 1: re-word the `why` to 「enforced (`live`, objectui `ActionRunner` `navigateOnSuccess`); not offered in the form pending a ruling」, and keep the omission;
  - sites 2 and 3: restate the reason. The group stays author-warned because `flows.FLOW.label` is unread (#20318), not because nothing reads the group.
- ⛔ No gating change: #20318's ENFORCE is what lifts the `flows` warn.

## A question this card records but does not rule

Should the Studio action metadata form now OFFER `onSuccess`? The omit entry itself defers that to 「a ruling for the enforcement」. It is a form-surface (capability) question, on the form-offer axis (#19332 / #19333); it is not text. The #20296 dev's measurement: no example or app produces `onSuccess` today.

## Dedupe

A local scan of every open and recently closed objectstack issue and PR for `authorWarnedTranslationGroups|metadata-form-zod-reconciliation…onSuccess|onSuccess…(offer|form)|i18n-flow-liveness-gate` found no card carrying these sites.
